takeoff_on_landing_roll.csv.notes: The take-off read on the landing roll, and its correction. Before: run bef, step 04 of commit b237a48 with the default settings. After: run aft4, step 04 of commit cc2604a with the default settings; the only difference is that a runway pass is read as a take-off only when it ends in the air (runway_take_off_needs_air_report). Tracks and flight list of run trk. The readings of the tracks ('second departure after a stop', ...) come from the reports of each track between the landing and 5 minutes after the take-off: lowest speed and reports on the ground between them, highest height and share of reports on the ground after the take-off; the 30 sampled tracks were read one by one.
